title: Fixed long freezes when some villagers joined the train
summary: The game could freeze for minutes when a cartographer appeared on the train or levelled up, while it worked out where its explorer maps lead. That search now runs in the background: the map trade shows "Working..." for a few seconds, then the map is ready to buy. Dungeon Train now needs Async Locator Refined installed, and the launchers add it for you.
highlights: No more freezes from cartographers' explorer maps
New required mod: Async Locator Refined (installed automatically by the CurseForge and Modrinth apps)
